newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two dead in French light plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in French light plane crash.

text.p: Two people were killed and four injured when a light aircraft overturned while making an emergency landing in a cornfield near Bayonne, near the Franco-Spanish border, police said on Sunday.
The plane attempted the landing late on Saturday when its engine failed, police said. No details on the identity of those involved were immediately available.
